Entity.name: Exclusive relationship
Entity.comment:
Relationships that emanate from an entity can be exclusive. I.e. none or 1 of them is possible, but never several simultaneously. Relationships in a group are all IsA relations or all functional relations.
Example: a Person is reachable via Mobile-Phone or via Land-Line-Phone
